Tesla Reports Huge Miss on Earnings for Second Quarter
videos.description: Tesla reports adjusted earnings of 33 cents a share for the second quarter. That was well short of the 51-cent average of analyst estimates compiled by Bloomberg. But sales were still strong. Jon McNeil of DVx Ventures shares his views on "Bloomberg The Close." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
